admin.title: Settings
admin.logLevelHint: Takes effect on the server's next restart.

agentAutoUpdate.title: Agent auto-update
agentAutoUpdate.hint: Periodically checks GitHub for a newer agent release, downloads it, and offers it to agents over their normal heartbeat — agents only ever download from this server, never from GitHub directly.
agentAutoUpdate.enabled: Check for and distribute new agent releases
agentAutoUpdate.checkIntervalHoursHint: How often to check GitHub for a newer agent release. Takes effect on the next check, no restart needed.
agentAutoUpdate.gitHubTokenHint: Raises GitHub's anonymous rate limit (60 requests/hour) to 5,000/hour. Not required.
agentAutoUpdate.checkNowDisabledHint: Enable and save the setting above to check manually.

manualUpload.title: Manual upload
manualUpload.hint: For a server that deliberately has no internet access: upload the release's .exe/.deb/.rpm files directly instead of checking GitHub. They're offered to agents exactly the same way either way.
manualUpload.filesHint: Up to one of each: .exe (Windows), .deb (Debian/Ubuntu), .rpm (RPM-based). The version is detected automatically from the file names — they must all be from the same release.

admin.passwordPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the current password
admin.notificationRecipientAddressHint: Where automated alert emails go — the certificate-expiry warning below, and the update-threshold notification. Leave empty to receive none of them (the checks themselves still run either way).

certificateExpiryNotifications.title: Certificate expiry notifications
certificateExpiryNotifications.hint: Turns the CA-root/server-certificate expiry emails above off entirely, independent of whether a recipient is configured. The server certificate's own automatic renewal (and both certificates' audit log entries) still happen either way — this only controls whether anyone gets emailed about it.

admin.adBindDnHint: Used to search the directory for the user logging in — needs read access, not admin rights.
admin.adUserSearchFilterHint: Must contain a {0} placeholder for the submitted username, e.g. (&(objectClass=user)(sAMAccountName={0})).
admin.adLoginGroupDnHint: Only members of this group are granted login — checked via the group's own "member" attribute.
admin.agentCertificateValidityDaysHint: Applies to newly issued or renewed agent certificates only, not retroactively to already-issued ones. Each CA root's own lifetime is fixed and isn't configurable — rotate it below instead once it's due.
admin.certificateExpiryWarningLeadDaysHint: How long before expiry the server acts: the server's own certificate (used for agent connections) renews itself automatically and sends a notice; the CA root does not renew itself and only gets a warning email — both need a notification recipient configured above to actually be emailed.

caRotation.title: Certificate authority root rotation
caRotation.hint: Three separate steps, not one "rotate now" button: prepare generates a new root without using it for anything yet; activate switches to it and re-issues this server's own certificate immediately (no restart needed); retire drops the old root once every agent has renewed past it. Wait for agents to pick up a prepared root on their own heartbeat cadence before activating — an agent that hasn't yet will briefly lose its connection to the server otherwise.
caRotation.downloadHint: Give this file to the Windows installer via /CACERT=<path>, or place it at /etc/updatewatch2/ca.pem before starting a Linux agent for the first time — so a freshly installed agent never has to trust the server's CA on first contact (trust-on-first-use) at all.
caRotation.activateConfirm: Activate the prepared root now? This server's own certificate switches immediately — make sure agents have had time to fetch the prepared root first.
caRotation.retireConfirm: Retire the previous root now? {{count}} agent(s) haven't renewed past it yet and will lose their connection until an admin re-issues their certificate.
caRotation.stillOnPreviousRoot: Agents still on the previous root: {{count}}
caRotation.unknownRootAgents: {{count}} agent(s) have a certificate issued before this could be tracked and can't be confirmed either way.

updateFilters.title: Update filters
updateFilters.hint: Any update whose title matches one of these regular expressions is excluded from the pending-updates count and list everywhere it's shown, and (once implemented) from the threshold email notification. Changes take effect immediately, no restart or new agent report needed.
updateFilters.name: Name
updateFilters.patternHint: Matched case-insensitively against the update title. Plain text works as a literal match — no regex syntax required unless you need one.
updateFilters.deleteConfirm: Delete the filter "{{name}}"? Updates it currently hides will reappear in the pending-updates display immediately.

admin.auditLogRetentionDaysHint: Entries older than this are permanently deleted by a periodic cleanup — lowering this also purges already-existing older entries on the next pass, not just new ones going forward.
